title: Tata Motors PV slides as JLR cuts outlook

timeline.title: Tata Motors PV slides as JLR cuts outlook
timeline.line: JLR now sees FY27 EBIT margin of 2–3% versus 4%, and a £1.25 billion cash outflow
more: The stock fell 7.5% to ₹265.90 in one report, nearly 9% in another
Analysts cite weak China demand, MENA disruption and an unfavourable mix
Q2 net loss is reported as ₹5,451 crore in one source, ₹5,531 crore in another

src.title: Tata Motors PV Shares Fall 7.5% After JLR Cuts FY27 Outlook
